claims.claim: Denison reported significant initial construction progress at the Phoenix ISR uranium mine in Q2 2026 while retaining about 1.1M lb of uranium holdings at June 30, giving the project both physical-market exposure and a financing buffer.

risks.risk: Phoenix remains a construction-stage mining project; execution, permitting, ramp and uranium-price sensitivity remain material.

unknowns.unknown: This Scout artifact does not independently validate Phoenix construction schedule/cost variance against the sanctioned baseline.

claims.claim: Denison sold 750,000 lb U3O8 in Q2 at an average realized US$89.17/lb, generating US$66.9M gross proceeds and a 233% gain versus acquisition cost; 600,000 lb were committed for deliveries through Q2 2027, supporting Phoenix financing execution.

risks.risk: Monetizing physical uranium reduces retained commodity upside and is not equivalent to recurring mine operating cash flow.
